about: Every source or test file old trillion (Trillion-X/trillion) deleted from 2026-10-10 (898d12d084) to its main at the time of reading that tools/check-deleted-code-names-its-home still finds no home for, grouped by the commit that deleted it, with that commit's own words quoted (its_words). The words are the deleting commit's reason, not a decision by the owner: none of these is retired until a row in retired-paths.json quotes the person who decided. Receipts were read in trillion-workshop, trillion-apps and trillion-rust at the commits read.receipts_read_in names; a file named by a moved-from.json receipt (from, source trillion) in any of them is no longer listed.

receipts_read_in.trillion-workshop: the commit that holds this ledger

commits.its_words: The web app shell lives in Trillion-X/trillion-apps web/ now, byte for byte from this main c9f7c79e64: every file the page's own bundle (src/workspace/main.tsx, screen-view.tsx, file-view.tsx, share-view.tsx, parts/device-copy/do-work/device-copy-worker.mjs) and the shell folders (src/workspace/, parts/ui/show/, scripts/build-workspace.mjs) hold that no server, script or computer code here imports, plus every part file and test that imports one of them: 3,229 files leave this repository.

Retire old trillion's Worker and everything only it reached: nothing live runs it (the public door is the Hetzner relay, the Mac engine is trillion-rust's trillion-local), and 7fd8838475 had already deleted 110 modules its graph imports, so it could no longer build.

The apps live in Trillion-X/trillion-apps now: macos/, ios/ (iPhone, Watch, share sheet, Live Activities), native-apps/, extension/, their release, signing, TestFlight and proof scripts, and every test that reads them (447 files) leave this repository, so no more app work happens here (Avery, Nov 3: move now even if it breaks the apps). src/heard-echo.mjs read the Mac's spoken words from macos/App/speak-aloud.json; it now reads the same longest_body and words from its own src/heard-echo.json spoken block. scripts/deploy-guard-tests.json drops the moved tests.
The ten engine library crates now have one home, in trillion-rust/crates; this app builds them from there
Old trillion main green again: resolve every import of a path #237, #243 and #251 deleted
The web shell lives only in trillion-apps web/: trillion deletes src/workspace, parts/ui/show, build-workspace.mjs and screen-modules.mjs
Old trillion deletes 1028 feature files that now live in the Workshop (trillion-workshop #76, f6fb197cd9)
trillion's copy of the traffic tools is deleted: trillion-workshop tools/traffic-attribution is the one copy
One routing: waiting work goes to the person's own AIs in their order; the always-on backup AI is deleted — source:aF81NzBlMjRiMjA0ZTI1NDg0NmFjODk1OTgtb25lLXJvdXRpbmctdjI
The Mac's drive tools run from the Workshop, one copy: trillion's computer/drive-tools is deleted

Cloudflare's adapters move into src/hosts/cloudflare/ and this computer's into src/hosts/local/ (decoupling H1), with the remaining supply shapes (P1b). src/resource-host.mjs is now the port only and names no host: each host installs { resource, identity, supply, installed, addressId, atId } by name (installHost), and the port installs src/hosts/cloudflare/resource-host.mjs cloudflareHost, which holds the Durable Object stub, the isAt id compare, the binding supply, the id strings and the raw-storage exits (exportHere ... retireHere, exportBucket) that the port names for product code, so no caller changes. The Cloudflare lines 67afc5c6bd added to src/resource-host.mjs (the supply adapter map) are moved into that adapter, not taken back. Moved with every importer repointed: the Worker entry (scripts/build-worker.mjs entry, deploy-worker), the Durable Object shell, the engines Worker, the hosted-Site entrypoints and the Worker Loader host into src/hosts/cloudflare/; local-resource-host and node:sqlite's seam (sqliteHost, still named by src/local-store.mjs for the ~790 tests and scripts that import it there) into src/hosts/local/. saved-module-host names no binding. scripts/reaches.json drops the port and the moved files' adapter rows (src/hosts/ covers them); guard-closure rows follow the moved paths (61 violations before and after); test/check-reaches.test.mjs no longer treats the port as an adapter. P1b: value, blob and service shapes in src/resource-placement.json, memory realizations, supply() answers a row's absent value. src/tools-in-this-worker.mjs stays: three of its importers are held by other chats.

Retire parts/document-sections: the Workshop's tools/document-sections already holds it (moved in trillion-workshop 4a0fa4b, 2026-10-30) with both tool rows and the same two tests byte for byte. Trillion's last change to the part (67e647a57a, 2026-10-02) came before the move, so nothing is carried. Nothing in trillion imported it; its mentions leave capabilities.json, parts/README.md, parts/documents/README.md, records/tool-folders.json (no longer a same-named folder to exclude) and scripts/port-sources.json.
